text_block_list.text:
On a day off, seeking a change of pace 
away from the city bustle, I took a stroll 
through a meadow on the outskirts of town—
—♪ Fufu—♪

...In the distance, I saw what looked like 
a fairy dancing across the grassy field. 
Worried that I might just be hallucinating 
from fatigue, I stepped closer—
—and found Yamanin Zephyr standing there.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—A cool breeze. A soft breeze. A gentle 
gust... I wonder what kind of wind will 
arrive next—
—Zephyr? Zephyr... right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Miracle-san. Were you drawn here by 
the wind?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry. Did I interrupt you? I was 
running and saw you from afar, so—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You looked like you were enjoying yourself 
so much, I just... couldn't help being 
pulled over.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My. Fufufu... I was simply bounding along, 
riding atop a pure, refreshing breeze, you 
see.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What called you here was surely a seasonal 
wind. ...Won't you frolic and leap about 
with me?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure? Wouldn't having me around 
get in the way of feeling that "wind"?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It will be fine. All we must do is become 
one with the wind together—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Fufu— Then I'd love to.

And so, Yamanin Zephyr and KS Miracle ran 
through the fields together... playing 
until they were both utterly exhausted.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Haa, haa...! That felt amazing... but, I 
think I've just about hit my limit...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, fuu... It feels as though the 
wind is still blowing through my heart—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. You're always amazing, but 
today especially so... Does the wind 
really give you power?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, indeed. The reason I am blowing so 
fiercely today is surely because... I am 
fulfilling the dream from that time.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: —That time?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...A long time ago— There was a frail, 
delicate child.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That child was very weak of body... and to 
heal, she would often rest within the 
verdant greenery of the forest...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What that delicate child yearned for above 
all else... was the wind blowing freely 
and wild, across open fields and through 
the trees.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be like that, too"... Even 
wishing so, she remained a frail child. 
She could not easily find a way to become 
the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yet, after searching for a very long 
time... at last, the child found it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—And even now... in order to fulfill the 
dream she had as a child, she embodies the 
wind in places that resemble those 
memories... That is how it is.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You run... simply aiming to become the 
wind.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—No matter how hard you tried, nothing 
worked... Yet finally, at long last, your 
hands reached it.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...That's truly wonderful. Really... 
things like that.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... If you would like, won't you join 
me once more in that wonderful pursuit?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, of course! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Haaahhh!

And so, the two of them became a fierce 
gust of wind... and ran on, boundlessly 
across the expanse.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Haaahhh!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Gh! As expected, what an incredible 
wind...!

Yamanin Zephyr left KS Miracle behind and 
surged ahead further and further— until 
she vanished beyond the horizon.
